messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm sketching a proposal for 'safety annotations' on automatic fallback events so the Console can show WHY a rollout switched into a degrade mode. Need input on what evidence we surface and how to keep it searchable.

ajay: Love this. Two quick asks: 1) a minimal, indexable event schema, 2) a compact UI card: Reason + Evidence + Actions.

sarah: Minimal fields I'd push: timestamp, trigger_type, trigger_value, decision, from_model, to_model, operator_override, trace_id, explain_text. Keep values as strings for easy ES indexing.

jamal: Also include 'quality_delta' and 'cost_delta' (strings like "-0.7%" / "-23%$") , and a short 'sample_input_id' so SRE can repro with the exact payload.

maria: Agreed. Thinking about retention TTL (compliance wants 1y optional). We should surface a tiny evidence bundle: sample request (first 256 chars), a single golden response, and a metric snapshot (p50/p95/err rate).

ajay: For telemetry cost we can store aggregated snapshots only, not full traces by default. But include a link to the traces-service (trace_id) for deep-dive.

maria: Example of the flattened event we could emit (pseudo):
```
trigger_type: "tail_latency",
trigger_value: ">2000ms",
decision: "fallback_to-3b-quant",
from_model: "gptx-8b:v2",
to_model: "gptx-3b-quant:v1",
sample_id: "req-2026-03-20-42",
trace_id: "trace-abcdef",
explain: "p95 exceeded 2s during canary; model fallback to lower-cost quantized variant",
operator_note: "auto (threshold=10% p95 increase)",
quality_delta: "-1.2%",
cost_delta: "-35%"
```

sarah: +1 to a human-readable 'explain' field. UI can show that first. Also recommend an immutable 'audit_id' that ties to rollout version and policy id.

jamal: UX question — when the auto-fallback happens, should the Console show a dismissible banner for customers? or keep it in the rollout timeline only?

maria: My take: small banner with link to timeline & evidence for high-severity fallbacks (SLA hit or >5% traffic). Lower-severity ones appear only in timeline. Ops can mute noisy policies.

ajay: We need an operator override action: 'force-stay-on' with required justification (free-text) that gets stored on the event as operator_override=true and operator_note="...". That must be auditable.

telemetry-bot: note: if you emit explain_text, please also attach a discrete 'signal_bucket' tag (latency/5xx/qa-loss/traffic-spike) so dashboards can pivot by cause.

sarah: For indexing, prefer these top-level tags: policy_id, rollout_id, signal_bucket, severity, decision. Rest goes into evidence blob link.

maria: Thoughts on schema evolution? We should version the event (event_schema_v) so older rollouts still parse. Also allow custom 'operator_tags' list for internal notes.

ajay: +1. Implementation constraints: keep primary doc shallow (no nested json), store full evidence in a separate object store with a pointer (evidence_uri). That keeps ES happy.

jamal: Security/compliance: if a customer is on Private, evidence URIs should be either tenant-scoped or disabled. We need opt-out and retention policy per tenant.

maria: Good catch. We'll add tenant_id and a 'private_mode' flag. Plan for feature gating in Console.

ajay: UX mock idea: timeline row with tiny pill: [AUTO-FALLBACK] -> hover shows explain + last 3 metric points + button "Open Evidence" -> opens trace/logs. Also an "Escalate" option to send to oncall.

sarah: Could we include a tiny 'repro_snippet' field with a sanitized curl so support can repro quickly? Keep it max 1KB.

maria: Yes — sanitized only, strip PII, and store as evidence_uri if present.

jamal: Final asks for the API team: 1) event write endpoint (/v1/rollout-events), 2) field-level validation docs, 3) retention & tenant params.

maria: I'll draft a short PR with schema (v0.1) and a Console mock. I'll @telemetry-bot and @eng-oncall for review. Thanks all, will ping for an async review. :thumbsup:
